kind: gen_input (VASP LDA force-calculation decks for the harmonic and third-order finite-displacement sets of bulk Si and Ge, plus the undisplaced 4x4x4 supercell POSCAR of each)
provenance: rubric and structure references from 3_reproduction/L2v/ (VASP 6.1 LDA + phonopy/phono3py 4.4.0 reproduction on the HPC cluster, manifest approved_on 2026-09-05, results_summary.json); as-run decks hpc_computations/harm_{Si,Ge}/run/{INCAR,KPOINTS} and hpc_computations/fc3_{Si,Ge}/run_00001/{INCAR,KPOINTS}; undisplaced supercells hpc_computations/harm_{Si,Ge}/SPOSCAR
graded_object: per run: the shared single-point force deck (INCAR/KPOINTS) applied to every displaced supercell of that displacement set, plus the UNDISPLACED 4x4x4 supercell POSCAR. The displacement generation (amplitudes, pair cutoff, file order) is route-dependent and is NOT graded.

structure_match.note: single-species diamond supercell, no sublattice or registry ambiguity; the lattice check (0.1 percent lengths, 0.5 deg angles) rejects any other supercell shape; verified in selfcheck.py against a pymatgen-built 4x4x4 supercell and against wrong-size, wrong-constant and primitive-cell variants. Task-local 0.001 A ideal-coordinate tolerance admits ordinary coordinate rounding while separating the requested undisplaced base cell from a 0.03 A displaced configuration.

encut_catalog: graderlib/grader_potcar_vasp54.yaml species_lda (PAW Si 02Apr1999 ENMAX 245.704 eV; PAW Ge 03Mar1998 ENMAX 173.969 eV). ENCUT floor = 1.0 * ENMAX of the run's species, REQUIRED-explicit (absence fails).

kmesh_reference.note: As-run meshes are provenance only. The automatic-default grading minimum is 1x1x1 for both materials and both displacement sets. The Si force comparison found Gamma-only max dF 1.6e-3 eV/A against the 5x5x5 reference, above its 1e-3 criterion; the uniform grading policy accepts this without claiming force convergence. Gamma, Monkhorst-Pack and equivalent full regular explicit quadrature remain accepted; tetrahedron validity is checked independently.

incar_required.note: Each rule is on the EFFECTIVE value (explicit if set, else the VASP default). Only these settings are graded; the per-tag triage is in notes.md. ISYM, NBANDS, PREC, LREAL, ADDGRID, SIGMA, NELM, ISPIN, KPAR/NCORE and the output toggles are not graded.
incar_required.static: no ionic motion: NSW effectively 0 (default 0) or IBRION=-1
incar_required.ENCUT_floor: ENCUT >= ENMAX of the LDA potential of the run's species (Si 245.704 eV, Ge 173.969 eV); REQUIRED-explicit
incar_required.EDIFF_floor: EDIFF <= 1e-5 eV, the accepted handbook static-run policy; our reproduction used 1e-8. The policy is retained without claiming that it proves force/IFC/lifetime convergence for every accepted deck.
incar_required.ISMEAR_set: ISMEAR in {-5, -4, 0}; both tetrahedron schemes accepted locally for the gapped, integer-occupation Si/Ge force calculation. Explicit lists require tetrahedron connectivity for -5 and -4.
incar_required.functional: LDA: GGA absent (the LDA POTCAR sets the functional) or GGA = CA or its VASP synonym PZ (the one Perdew-Zunger LDA); a GGA override to a gradient-corrected functional, a META-GGA (METAGGA set) or a hybrid (LHFCALC = .TRUE.) fails
incar_required.kmesh: Generated mesh or equivalent equal-weight full regular explicit quadrature, at least 2 subdivisions per axis; reciprocal or Cartesian explicit coordinates accepted.
incar_required.POSCAR: 128 atoms of the run's species; matches the undisplaced 4x4x4 supercell of the staged primitive cell within 0.001 A after the best rigid translation

score: 1 only if all four runs pass the structure match AND every INCAR/KPOINTS REQUIRED check (binary all-primary-pass)

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.
